C5c-02 opens (the second check pass, pass 6). Read AGENT.md, the head, the stage file, diary --last 5, validate.py --open C5 (0 errors, 0 warnings). The field analyst's second reading is back (out/sources-from-J/RETURN-field-C5.jsonl, written by J's Codex session at 08:43Z; the reader saw none of my codes or the fleet's verdicts): 268 sentence lines, 117 not standing, 72 Stigmergy codes and 36 notes on declarations. This pass: read every line; compare its verdicts on the 40 sentences the fleet also judged; decide Stigmergy's cut with three codings under a rule written before the tally; amend the declarations once, each amendment a move; answer each point; then the pass line and the close.

Stigmergy's cut with three codings: the rule, written before the field analyst's codes are tallied. (1) Each of the 72 records takes the code at least two of its three coders gave: mine (C5a-01), the fleet reader who coded its member theme (C5c-01), and the field analyst. MP counts as M, as the rule of the read counts it, so codes reduce to M, P and O. (2) Where the three give M, P and O once each, the record is doubtful; I compute the member's verdict with it as M, as P and as O, and where the verdict changes, I read the doubtful records whole and decide, saying why. (3) A member joins what the sources keep apart if P is at least half of its records that are not O (the rule of the read, unchanged). (4) What follows, as written before the read: if T3-041 meets the rule, it moves to Collective representation (T4-006), where proposals of what the mark shows already sit; if T3-038 meets it, I report it, since a split of a third-order theme reassigns second-order themes. T3-060 had no destination written. I write it now, before the tally: if T3-060 meets the rule, it moves to Collective representation too, for the same reason as T3-041 (its proposals are proposals of what the shared mark shows). (5) If no member meets the rule, Stigmergy keeps its cut, and the account reports the three codings.

Working hypothesis: by the three-coder rule logged before the tally (c5c2_stigmergy_three.py), T3-041 (P in 8 to 10 of 15 not O, whichever way its two three-way splits fall) and T3-060 (P in 10 of 20, exactly half) meet the rule and move from Stigmergy (T4-007) to Collective representation (T4-006); T3-038 does not (4 of 14). Pairwise agreement: mine-fleet 57 of 72 (kappa 0.69), mine-field 47 (0.47), fleet-field 48 (0.50). That leaves Stigmergy one member, a rename under C2's criterion for a fourth-order theme; my leaning is to withdraw T4-007 and rest P03 on T3-038 with dimension D02, as R01 rests on third-order themes, keeping the name as a gloss of what T3-038's records show. The recount on the recut element sets (c2_elements_c5c2.json; c5c2_arrow_evidence.txt): A01 81 of 126 (0.643, p95 0.571, beats, now fair), A03 148 of 190 (0.779, p95 0.389), A07 139 of 182 (0.764, p95 0.434), A11 111 of 185 (0.600, p95 0.670, still does not beat; theorised); every tested arrow still beats its null. Nothing written to a ledger, declaration or account yet. Next: check stage_C2.py's rules for a withdrawn fourth-order theme and for a third-order theme outside every fourth (lines 372 to 610: members, the dimension check, the foot of fourth.md); then write the recut as moves (tier_history: T3-041, T3-060 merging into T4-006, T4-006 members and prose, T4-007 dropped, D02 members; model/history: P02, P03, A01, A03, A07, A11), F-016 superseded and a finding for the three codings, mapping-C3 T4-007 amended, propositions' counts, the account's Stigmergy paragraph and counts; then read the field return's 268 verdicts and 36 notes, compare its 40 with the fleet's, amend the declarations once, each a move; then the pass 6 line, notes and close.

C5c-02-p2 opens, resuming pass 6 from the pause. Read AGENT.md, the head, the stage file, diary --last 5, validate.py --open C5 (0 errors, 0 warnings). J (11:02 Amsterdam), through the handler: the 117 sentences the field analyst marked as not standing are advice to improve the model, not evidence that the model does not apply unless it says so; I keep control of the model. The handler: the count of 117 measures nothing; change a sentence where the advice, read against the members' quotes, convinces me, keep my wording where it does not and say why in a line; report which I accepted and which I kept. The plan stands as logged at the pause: the validator's rules, the Stigmergy recut and its knock-ons, then the field return.

T3-041 and T3-060 Move (merging): both leave Stigmergy (T4-007) for Collective representation (T4-006), by the rule logged before the three-coder tally. Each record took the code two of three coders gave (mine, the fleet reader of its member theme, the field analyst): T3-041 has P in 8 to 10 of 15 records not O, however its two three-way splits fall; T3-060 has P in 10 of 20, exactly half; both meet the rule of the read (P at least half), and by the destination written before the read both go where proposals of what the mark shows sit. T4-006 now has 14 members; its prose names the two new acts with quotes [twice/c0057, TransFlagPlace/c0253] and 535 of 705 rooms (was 483). P02's statement widens to adding to or enlarging the mark and adding a personal piece (model/history). Coders' agreement: mine-fleet 57 of 72 (kappa 0.69), mine-field 47 (0.47), fleet-field 48 (0.50). Findings touched: F-016 (information provision counted Stigmergy's three members), superseded in the next step.

T4-007 Move (splitting): Stigmergy keeps T3-038 (building and reporting the mark, 237 rooms) alone. Three coders read 10 of its 14 bearing records as reports of the work's state and 4 as proposals, so the remaining member carries the trace the construct names (Heylighen 2016, p. 9: a shared record of the work's state as medium). Kept, not withdrawn: a fourth-order line must keep members (stage_C2 check), and withdrawing it would leave T3-038 in no fourth-order theme and P03, on the spine, outside its dimension. The cost is said in the prose: a one-member theme breaks C2's criterion for a group, since it answers no question its member does not answer alone; the name is a reading of one third-order theme. 'changed' now says the proposals sit under Collective representation; the gloss is replaced by a T3-038 record [physical_removal/c0012], since starbound/c0082 sits under celebration and credit. P03's statement narrows to reporting the mark's state; its evidence codes are T3-038 records the coders read alike.
